key_insight: State-augmented reinforcement learning controls synthetic jets around elliptical cylinders, achieving complete vortex-shedding suppression and up to 32.2% drag reduction at aspect ratio Ar = 0.1.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a path to reducing drag and stabilizing wakes around slender bodies with challenging flow dynamics.
method: Learn synthetic-jet actuation strategies using deep reinforcement learning.
Evaluate flow control across elliptical-cylinder aspect ratios.
Enrich dynamic state features and apply Kalman-filtered state estimation for Ar = 0.1.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports drag reductions of 13.4%, 20.1%, 26.88%, and 30.37% at Ar = 1, 0.75, 0.5, and 0.25, respectively, with a maximum of 32.2% at Ar = 0.1.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish net energy savings after accounting for synthetic-jet actuation costs.
paper_title: State-augmented deep reinforcement learning for active flow control around an elliptical cylinder
